performance.verdict: No paid activity; 5 overdue SOW milestones block every revenue path.

findings.text: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, and Site/Landing Pages were all due 2026-07-31 — now 36 days overdue with no completed event recorded.
Ads Launch (LSA + Search) and Meta Retargeting were due 2026-08-01 — 35 days overdue; $0 spend across all 28 days confirms neither went live.
GBP actions fell to 0 for the last 4 consecutive days (2026-09-01–04) after averaging ~3.5/day the prior 3 weeks — a confirmed 4-day activity drought.
GHL shows 105 contacts and 32 opportunities created but 0 appointments and 0 won — leads arriving via unknown source, none converting to consultations.

suggestions.text: Escalate all 5 overdue SOW milestones to Nacer immediately; no paid media can run until stack test and site are cleared.
suggestions.monday_update: Five milestones are 35–36 days overdue: Pre-Launch Stack Test, LSA Verification, Site/Landing Pages, Ads Launch, and Meta Retargeting — all confirmed by $0 spend across 28 days. Nacer (Ops) must sign off on the stack test and site before any ad account can go live. Success check: all 5 milestones marked complete in Monday and confirmed by Sohib by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Investigate GBP listing for suspension or suppression; 4 straight zero-action days after a period averaging 3–6 actions/day is anomalous.
suggestions.monday_update: GBP actions dropped to 0 for 4 consecutive days (Sep 1–4) after averaging roughly 3–6 actions/day through most of August. Check the GBP dashboard for any suspension notice, ownership conflicts, or policy flags. Success check: actions return above 2/day within 7 days of any corrective action, confirmed by 2026-09-12.

suggestions.text: Watch GHL pipeline: 32 opps, 0 appointments, 0 won — identify lead source and confirm intake routing before ads add volume.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL has 105 contacts and 32 opportunities but zero appointments booked and zero cases won, indicating an intake routing or follow-up gap — not an ads problem. Before any paid traffic is activated, confirm that routing rules, auto-reply, and calendar booking are functioning end-to-end as specified in the SOW. Re-check appointment count on 2026-09-12 to confirm the pipeline is moving.
